visualCharacteristics.structure: sticky full-screen video scrubbed by scroll position

contentPattern: One row: cell 1 = poster picture(s) (landscape, optional portrait crop); cell 2 = video link(s) (.fsv frame sequence or .mp4/.webm; landscape, optional portrait).
reuseGuidance: Use for a scroll-controlled product reveal (video that plays forward/backward with the scroll). For autoplaying loops use hero-product or cards-bento; for a still image use default content.
